messages.subject: [Genabel-announce] A new tool in the GenABEL suite: CollapsABEL
messages.subject_clean: [Genabel-announce] A new tool in the GenABEL suite: CollapsABEL
messages.body_plain:
Dear GenABEL users,

We are happy to announce a new tool has been included in the GenABEL
suite: CollapsABEL. CollapsABEL is an R package that allows detection
of compound heterozygote alleles in GWAS. A paper describing the package
has been published in BMC Bioinformatics [1].

The main web page for CollapsABEL is
http://www.genabel.org/packages/CollapsABEL, and the source code can
be found in a repository on Github [2]. Bugs can be reported in
the associated bug tracker [3] and questions about this
package can be asked on the forum [4].


With best regards,

Lennart Karssen.

[1] DOI: 10.1186/s12859-016-1006-9 URL:
http://www.biomedcentral.com/1471-2105/17/156
[2] https://github.com/kindlychung/collapsabel2
[3] https://github.com/kindlychung/collapsabel2/issues
[4] http://forum.genabel.org
-- 
*-*-*-*-*-*-*-*-*-*-*-*-*-*-*-*-*-*-*-*-*-*-*-*-*
L.C. Karssen
Utrecht
The Netherlands

lennart at karssen.org
http://blog.karssen.org
